messages:
Maya: Hey folks, thinking of piloting a tiny recognition drop next Wed: 'Cozy Cup' - short kudos in Slack + optional hand-delivered mini cards for onsite folks. Low lift. Anyone up to help with comms, bot, and fulfillment?
Samir: Love the name. Minimal MVP: slash command + ephemeral confirmation.
Jess: I can build /cozy give @user <badge> <one-liner>. Will add 2/min throttle and a per-user daily cap.
Maya: Perfect. Proposed badges: 'Warm Help', 'Small Win', 'Bench Buddy', 'Ship Push', 'Spark Note'. Short blurbs later.
Katie: Ill do the comm copy and a one-pager. Also sample announcement for All-Hands.
Nora: For cards: estimate 120 cards. Ops-bot, can you create a quick RSVP/address form?
Ops-bot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/cozy-cup-cards fields: giver, recipient, delivery preference, desk address. Closes in 6 days.
Hector: Can analytics show team-level counts only? No free-text in metrics please.
Jess: Yup — metrics will include badge id, giver team, count buckets. Free-text stays only in the Slack thread.
Nora: I can handle printing & hand drops if budget approved (~$140). Who signs off?
Maya: I'll submit expense and tag finance.
Samir: Moderation cover during lunch? I can be on for 11:30-12:15 PT.
Katie: Im in for comms moderation and FAQ.
Jess: Plan: deploy to staging Tue EOD, prod Wed morning. Ill post usage examples.
Maya: Small sync Fri 9:00 AM PT to finalize copy, badges, and PO. 15 min. Who can join?
Everyone: In.
Maya: Thanks all  Ill drop the draft one-pager by Thu and send the invite :coffee:
